purpose: Adult ICU cross-context technical replication, not intraoperative or clinical-outcome external validation
source: MIMIC-IV Waveform 0.1.0 linked to locally available MIMIC-IV 3.1 clinical tables
waveform_scan: All available systemic arterial channels throughout all 64 waveform-candidate records, not sampled blocks
reference: Original monitor numeric MAP 10-second medians, same preselected arterial family as feasibility audit; no cross-family substitution or reference filling
time_grid: Original record-start-anchored 10-second grid, never compressed after QC; partial terminal bins excluded

waveform_bin_quality.flatline: Absolute adjacent physical-sample difference <=0.01 mmHg for >=5 continuous seconds; every intersecting 10-second bin is masked
waveform_bin_quality.unavailable_waveform: Not quality-certified; mask numeric reference for waveform-supported analysis
waveform_bin_quality.pulsatility_sensitivity: Additionally require whole-bin observed waveform range 10-150 mmHg
waveform_bin_quality.numeric_coherence_sensitivity: Additionally require same-family 20<=DBP<=MAP<=SBP<=250 and pulse pressure10-150 using 10-second medians
waveform_bin_quality.label: Automated signal quality flags, not clinician-confirmed artefacts

primary_cohort: Confirmed adult and entire record within linked ICU interval; original record >=60min and >=80% numeric10s bins remain valid after full matching-family waveform QC
window_sensitivity: Each confirmed adult ICU record's earliest complete 60-minute window with >=80% QC-valid bins; choose only by coverage, never hypotension or results; retain absolute global sampling phase
phases: Every offset on original10s grid,30 offsets0-290s for5min
primary_display: Latest finite scheduled sample carried forward; unavailable before first valid scheduled sample; missing reference excluded from numerators and denominator
startup_sensitivities: Initialize display with first finite reference
Exclude time before first finite display
Exclude first5min of record without resetting original schedule
events: Contiguous QC-valid MAP<threshold for>=60s; gaps always break events; fresh within-event low sample takes priority over inherited-only display, then never-low
event_robustness: At MAP65 and5min, minimum low-run180s and300s;10s or20s observed normal gaps may bridge runs but missing data never bridges; cumulative low duration excludes normal gaps
uncertainty: 1000 nonparametric subject-cluster percentile bootstrap, seed20260706; phases averaged within record before resampling; ratios recomputed from sums; no significance-driven selection
units: State discordance minutes per original ICU-record hour; TWA deficit per QC-valid reference minute
exclusions: No vasopressor-response, AKI or clinical-benefit analysis in this technical replication
support_assessment: Judge bidirectional magnitudes, cancellation relative to absolute error, event/fresh-sampling losses and interval trend separately; quantify discrepancies, do not require exact VitalDB numerical agreement or select favourable sensitivity
